Implementation Plan

I couldn't confirm the free-disk-space SHA in this run. Planning has no network (`git ls-remote` failed: "Could not resolve host: github.com"). The implement editor runs with `--network none` too, so it almost certainly can't check either. The plan therefore treats the SHA check as a gate whose expected result is "unconfirmed", and the split fallback (SEC-002 only) is the default path. That means the movable `@v1.3.1` tag (SEC-001) will most likely stay open.

---

# Plan: unblock fix-up #7357-r1. Stop putting `secrets.GH_PAT` into `run:` scripts (SEC-002); pin free-disk-space only if its SHA is verified (SEC-001)

Refs #7355 (tracking issue; never use a closing keyword against it). Item: #7357.

## Planning ref context
- `git rev-parse HEAD`: `3d87725214090f72ed05e36971a589c42dd3b242`
- Branch: `orchestrator/project-7355`. This matches the integration branch metadata, so there is no mismatch.

## Automation / scheduler / supervisor (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** this only changes existing workflow files and one existing test file. It adds no new script and needs no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry.
- **Wiring:** none to add. The test goes into `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py`, which `.github/workflows/ci.yml` already runs (`ci.yml:1359`).
- **Supervisor or DB work:** none.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py
Scope-mode justification: The re-issued spec says exactly what to do. Fix SEC-002 in the two named push steps. Pin SEC-001 only when the SHA can be verified as `54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be`. Add one test assertion and a changelog fragment. Both findings are still present on the planning ref: `review_autofix.yml:1938` uses `jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v1.3.1`, and `implement.yml:5153` / `review_autofix.yml:4591` put `${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` into `git remote set-url`. A repo-wide search found exactly those two `x-access-token:${{` sites, so the fix and a repo-wide guard cost only a few lines. No other workflows are touched.

## Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/implement.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py`
- `changelog.d/unblock-7357-r1-push-token-env.md`

## Functions or modules to implement

### Step 0: SHA verification gate (decides which branch of the plan runs)
1. Run `git ls-remote https://github.com/jlumbroso/free-disk-space 'refs/tags/v1.3.1*'`. If a `refs/tags/v1.3.1^{}` line exists, use its SHA. Otherwise use the `refs/tags/v1.3.1` line.
2. If that fails, try the unauthenticated public API `GET https://api.github.com/repos/jlumbroso/free-disk-space/git/ref/tags/v1.3.1`. If `object.type == "tag"`, follow `object.url` to the commit it points at. Otherwise use `object.sha`.
3. The check is **confirmed** only when the result equals `54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be` exactly. A network error, a different value, or any doubt means **unconfirmed**. Never write a SHA you did not observe.
4. In this pipeline the editor runs network-isolated, so expect **unconfirmed**. Do not emit `BLOCKED:` in that case; follow branch B.

### Branch A: SHA confirmed (steps 1–3 of #7357)
- `review_autofix.yml`, step "Free disk space": change `uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v1.3.1` to `uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be # v1.3.1`. Leave the `with:` block unchanged.
- Make the SEC-002 edits (below).
- Add the test assertions, including the pin assertion (below).

### Branch B: SHA unconfirmed (default)
- Leave the `uses:` line unchanged.
- Make only the SEC-002 edits and the `x-access-token:${{ secrets.` test assertion.

### SEC-002 edits (both branches)
- `implement.yml`, step "Push branch" (line ~5153):
  - Replace `git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}"` with `git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"`.
  - The step env already has `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`.
  - `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is a default Actions variable and has the same value as `github.repository`.
- `review_autofix.yml`, step "Push all pending commits" (line ~4591):
  - Make the same replacement.
  - The step env already binds `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` and `GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}`, so per the spec ("add if missing") no env change is needed. Check this before editing, and add `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` only if it turns out to be absent.
- Keep the literal `github.com` host. Changing it to `${SERVER_HOST}` would change behaviour and is out of scope.
- Do not change any other line in these steps. These are one-line edits in each step, with no reformatting.

## Data structures affected
None. The remote URL, the token value and the push behaviour stay the same. Only the way the secret reaches the script changes: it now comes from step env instead of being written into the script text when the workflow is compiled.

## API or interface changes
None. Step names, ids, `if:` conditions, `env:` keys and outputs are unchanged (§10).

## Decisions

### D1 — How the free-disk-space SHA is decided
- Chosen: a fixed check (`git ls-remote`, then the public git-ref API) that must equal the SHA the issue gives. If it doesn't, split the work and ship SEC-002 alone.
- Alternatives considered: `BLOCKED:` until a person supplies the SHA (the previous run did this); pin the SHA from the issue text without checking it.
- Why: the unblock judge asked for no block. An unverified SHA in `uses:` would be invented supply-chain data (§2 / §17). SEC-002 does not depend on the SHA.

### D2 — Where the token comes from in the remote URL
- Chosen: `${GH_TOKEN}` and `${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}` from the step env that is already there.
- Alternatives considered: a one-shot credential helper like the one in `nightly-validation-selftest.yml`; moving the push body into a `scripts/` file.
- Why: this is the smallest change and matches the existing pattern in `clarify.yml:212` and `implement.yml:1056`. It keeps the secret out of the compiled script body.

### D3 — Where the test goes
- Chosen: a new test function in `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py` that scans `.github/workflows/*.yml` and `workflow-templates/*.yml` for `x-access-token:` followed by `${{ secrets.` (whitespace-tolerant regex).
- Alternatives considered: a new test file; asserting only the two edited lines.
- Why: that file is already wired into CI (`ci.yml:1359`). A repo-wide scan also stops the pattern from coming back in other workflows.

## Security considerations
- **Trust boundary:** the repository secret `GH_PAT` flowing into `run:` shell text. With `${{ secrets.X }}` the secret becomes part of the generated script file and is exposed to anything that reads or echoes the script. With env binding it reaches the shell only as an environment variable, and log masking still applies.
- **Authorization:** no new endpoints or surfaces. The push still uses the same PAT and the same permissions.
- **External input:** none. `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` comes from the runner, not from untrusted input.
- **Abuse cases:**
  - An action tag moved to malicious code. This is SEC-001. It stays open on branch B and is called out in the changelog.
  - Copy-pasting the secret-interpolation pattern into a new workflow. The new test prevents this.
- **Supply chain:** a SHA pin is written only after the check confirms it. A wrong pin either breaks the job, or, if it was guessed, points at code nobody reviewed.

## Risks and edge cases
- **Conflict with issue wording:** the issue says to add `GH_TOKEN` to the review_autofix push step env "if it is missing". It is already present, along with `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`. Nothing to add.
- **Implement-step env:** `implement.yml` "Push branch" has no explicit `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` in its env. The runner always sets it, so the URL is unchanged.
- **`set -u`:** both steps run `set -euo pipefail`. `GH_TOKEN` is always set from env (empty only if the secret itself is missing, which would already break the current line), so `set -u` cannot trip on it.
- **Workflow size:** `review_autofix.yml` is 352,239 bytes and `implement.yml` is 368,788 bytes. Both are under the 480,000-byte guard (§24), and the edits make each file slightly smaller.
- **actionlint:** expression removal only. No new actionlint findings are expected.
- **Branch B outcome:** SEC-001 stays open. The changelog fragment must say so explicitly and say it was split off, so a later operator or session with network access can pin it.
- **Test false positives:** the regex must match only `x-access-token:` immediately followed by optional whitespace and `${{ secrets.`. The existing `x-access-token:%s` and `x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}` forms must not match.

## Testing considerations
- **New test `test_workflows_do_not_interpolate_secrets_into_remote_urls`:**
  - Reads every `.github/workflows/*.yml` and `workflow-templates/*.yml`.
  - Asserts that `re.compile(r"x-access-token:\s*\$\{\{\s*secrets\.")` finds no match, and names the file and line on failure.
  - Also asserts that the two push steps contain `x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}`. Read `review_autofix.yml` raw, because this step body is inline and not a moved step script.
- **Branch A only:** assert that `review_autofix.yml` contains `jlumbroso/free-disk-space@54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be` and no `jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v`. Do not add this assertion on branch B.
- **Run:**
  - `python3 -m pytest tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py`
  - `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py`
  - `tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py`, because it asserts on other `set-url` forms and the run confirms nothing regressed
  - `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`
  - `actionlint` on both edited workflows, if available on the pinned toolchain (otherwise ma
